ModMetaData.author: ZRui-C
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimTalk - Expand Actions Core / 行为扩展[/h1] [i]让对话驱动行为——小人说什么就做什么 / Let dialogue drive behavior - when pawns say it, they do it.[/i]
[h2]中文说明[/h2]
行为扩展 (EA) 让对话驱动行为——小人说什么就做什么。
[h3]功能[/h3] - [b]对话转行为[/b]：LLM 输出自动转换为游戏动作，支持中英文关键词 - [b]行为队列[/b]：同一小人按序执行，不同小人并行 - [b]智能物品匹配[/b]：100+ 模糊关键词，武器/食物/药品/服装等 - [b]上下文感知[/b]：征召中/工作中的小人自动跳过 - [b]50+ 动作[/b]：移动、战斗、医疗、社交、物品、生产、动物、DLC 等 - [b]安全控制[/b]：逐个动作开关、任务白名单、精神状态白名单 - [b]可扩展[/b]：插件模块系统，支持第三方行为包
另外支持 XXX（如果你知道我说的是啥）。
[h3]自动提示词注入[/h3] EA 会自动将行为格式说明注入到 RimTalk 的提示词系统中，无需手动配置。 你可以在 RimTalk 的提示词编辑器中查看、禁用或删除 "EA Action Schema" 条目。删除后不会重新添加。
---
[h2]English[/h2]
Expand Actions bridges LLM dialogue and in-game pawn behavior. When a character says "I'll go chop some wood", EA makes them actually do it.
[h3]Features[/h3] - [b]Dialogue → Action[/b]: LLM text automatically converted to game actions via pattern matching (CN/EN) - [b]Action Queue[/b]: Multiple actions execute in order; different pawns run in parallel - [b]Smart Item Matching[/b]: 100+ fuzzy keywords for weapons, food, medicine, apparel, etc. - [b]Context-Aware Prompts[/b]: Template variables auto-disable for drafted/working pawns - [b]50+ Actions[/b]: Movement, combat, medical, social, items, production, animals, DLC, and more - [b]Safety Controls[/b]: Per-action toggles, job whitelist, mental state whitelist - [b]Extensible[/b]: Plugin module system for third-party action packs
And support XXX(if you know what I mean).
[h3]Auto Prompt Injection[/h3] EA automatically injects its action schema into RimTalk's prompt system — no manual configuration needed. You can view, disable, or delete the injected entry "EA Action Schema" in RimTalk's Prompt Editor. Deleted entries will not be re-added.
---
[h2]更新日志 / Changelog[/h2] [b]0.3.0-beta.1[/b] - Fix: 精简 ea_observed schema 提示词，移除冗余指令减少 token 消耗
[b]0.3.0-beta.0[/b] - Beta release / Beta 发布：EA 行为扩展核心模块（对话 → 物理动作） - i18n keywords / 多语言关键词：支持中/英文关键词 + 多语言关键词配置（含英文回退注入） - Auto prompt injection / 自动提示词注入：RimTalk PromptEntry: "EA Action Schema" - Optional dependency / 可选依赖：Expand Memory 推荐用于行为记录
[h3]推荐 API / Recommended API[/h3] 推荐使用硅基流动 (SiliconFlow) 的 DeepSeek V3.2 模型，效果好价格便宜： https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/w2BnqakO
[h3]Requirements / 依赖[/h3] - Harmony - RimTalk v4.0+ - (Optional) RimTalk - Expand Memory (behavior recording / 行为记录)
